name: Ship limit
desc: Limits the total number of ship entries in the fleet definition. Each entry counts once and the configured value is the inclusive upper limit.

name: DP limit
desc: Limits the combined deployment point cost of all assembled fleet members. Their individual deployment costs are summed and compared with the configured upper limit.

name: Same hull limit
desc: Limits the number of ships sharing the same hull ID. Each hull ID is checked separately; different loadouts of that hull share the same allowance.

name: Frigate limit
desc: Limits the total number of frigates in the assembled fleet. Each member whose hull size is FRIGATE counts once toward the configured upper limit.

name: Destroyer limit
desc: Limits the total number of destroyers in the assembled fleet. Each member whose hull size is DESTROYER counts once toward the configured upper limit.

name: Cruiser limit
desc: Limits the total number of cruisers in the assembled fleet. Each member whose hull size is CRUISER counts once toward the configured upper limit.

name: Capital ship limit
desc: Limits the total number of capital ships in the assembled fleet. Each member whose hull size is CAPITAL_SHIP counts once toward the configured upper limit.

name: Fighter wing limit
desc: Limits the total number of fighter wing entries across all assembled ship variants. Each installed wing counts once toward the fleet-wide allowance.

name: S-mod limit
desc: Limits the total number of S-mods across the assembled fleet including enhanced built-in hullmods. Each distinct S-mod counts once per ship; the same S-mod on several ships counts once for each ship.

name: Officer limit
desc: Limits the number of fleet members assigned officer skills. Each member with at least one configured officer skill counts as one officer.

name: Officer skill limit
desc: Limits the number of distinct configured skills per officer. Each officer is checked separately and repeated entries for an elite skill count as one skill.

name: Elite skill limit
desc: Limits the number of elite skills per officer. A skill ID appearing more than once in that officer's configured skill list counts as one elite skill; each officer is checked separately.

name: Fleet skill limit
desc: Limits the number of distinct skills configured for the fleet commander. Each different skill ID counts once toward the fleet-wide upper limit.

name: Allowed mods
desc: Restricts ship hulls and refittable weapons, fighter wings and hullmods to the listed source mod IDs. Use vanilla for base-game content. Every checked item requires a known source matching a listed ID.

name: Weapon blacklist
desc: Blocks weapons whose IDs appear in the list. Applies to weapons fitted in refittable slots across the assembled fleet; each matching weapon is reported as a violation.

name: Weapon whitelist
desc: Restricts weapons fitted in refittable slots to the listed weapon IDs. Every checked weapon requires an exact listed ID; an empty list permits zero refittable weapons.

name: Fighter wing blacklist
desc: Blocks fighter wings whose IDs appear in the list. Applies to refittable wings across the assembled fleet; each matching wing is reported as a violation.

name: Fighter wing whitelist
desc: Restricts refittable fighter wings to the listed wing IDs. Every checked wing requires an exact listed ID; an empty list permits zero refittable wings.

name: Hullmod blacklist
desc: Blocks refittable hullmods whose IDs appear in the list including S-mods made from those hullmods. Each matching hullmod on each assembled ship is reported as a violation.

name: Hullmod whitelist
desc: Restricts refittable hullmods to the listed hullmod IDs including S-mods made from those hullmods. Every checked hullmod requires an exact listed ID; an empty list permits zero refittable hullmods.

name: Hull blacklist
desc: Blocks ships whose hull IDs appear in the list. Each assembled ship is checked by its exact hull ID and all loadouts of a listed hull are affected.

name: Hull whitelist
desc: Restricts ships to the listed hull IDs. Each assembled ship requires an exact listed hull ID; all loadouts of an allowed hull qualify and an empty list permits zero ships.
